test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Naïve’ from the given sentence.**

After years of working in politics, she had become naive and jaded, convinced that all politicians were cynical and that the system was rigged against the people.
solution: The correct answer is "Cynical."** *__Key Points__ __ • The word "Naive" means without enough experience of life and too ready to believe or trust other people. (जिसे जीवन का पर्याप्त अनुभव नहीं और जो दूसरों पर तुरंत विश्‍वास या भरोसा कर लेता है; भोला-भाला) • Example:* I was too **naive**__ to realize what was happening.* • The antonym of "Naive" is "Cynical." • The word "Cynical" means believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity or integrity. (हरेक को स्‍वार्थी समझने वाला) __ • Example: That was a **cynical**__ remark.* • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Jaded: **tired and bored after doing the same thing for a long time without a break. (लगातार लंबे समय तक एक ही काम करने से थका और ऊबा हुआ; थका-माँदा; थककर चूर) • **Corrupt: **doing or involving illegal or dishonest things in exchange for money, etc. (धन के बदले ग़ैर-कानूनी काम करना अथवा संलिप्त होना; भ्रष्‍ट) • **Convinced: **completely sure about something. (किसी विषय में पूर्णतया आश्‍वस्‍त) 13b:Tb25, The correct answer is '**ironed out**'.
